https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/6a7bcda42de7b98196b38924cc354216eba57c9b/src/Middleware/HttpLogging/src/ResponseBufferingStream.cs#LL86C47-L86C74

review_comments: Oh right, forgot about this change. You aren't allowed to use generics in attributes. And since int is a struct, `int?` is actually `Nullable<int>`. We'll need to update the approved API.
